port_domains.source: the tile's pad reset, into tt_um_r2r_dac_digital's synchroniser

assumptions: mode (tt_pins uio_in[1:0]) is taken as synchronous to clock.primary (clk): what drives it is the board's; declare it in spec/cdc.yaml ports if it is not
slow (tt_pins uio_in[2]) is taken as synchronous to clock.primary (clk): what drives it is the board's; declare it in spec/cdc.yaml ports if it is not
ui_in (tt_pins ui_in[7:0]) is taken as synchronous to clock.primary (clk): what drives it is the board's; declare it in spec/cdc.yaml ports if it is not

scope.why: the generated wrapper tt_um_r2r_dac_digital and the block: rst_n through the wrapper's 2-flop pad reset synchroniser on clk

not_checked: that data a handshake or mux-enable qualifies is held stable at its source while the enable is seen
reconvergence after a further flop in the destination domain
recovery/removal timing of a synchronised release (STA's)
a data path from a flop with no reset into a flop with one
a raw reset read synchronously, other than tt_pins's pad reset (a data input: declare it `async` in ports to check it)
